Name: Hueless Haven 1.6 compatible desaturated map recolour for Content Patcher (CP)
Author: lydocia
Description:
[size=3][img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_description.png[/img]

A map recolour that desatures the bright headache-inducing of the default map.

This mod makes no visual changes other than reducing the brightness. 

Since the maps have changed and maps have been added in 1.6, there may be some inconsistencies that I overlooked.
Please report any issues you find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab). Thank you!

[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_install.png[/img]
[/size][list=1]
[size=3]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
3. Download the .zip file and extract into your /Mods folder
[/size][/list][size=3]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hr.png[/img]
[img]https://www.lydocia.com/mods/stardewvalley/img/_hdr_bugreports.png[/img]

If you have any [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]-specific issues, direct them to the devs on their respective mod page.﻿

Report any other issues you may find in the 'Bugs' tab (as I might miss them in the general posts tab).
Please include a detailed description of the issue and any screenshots if you can!
